run_kuka_simulation: run the pybullet kuka robot simulation with gripper and environment objects loaded
load_urdf_objects: load URDF robot models like kuka iiwa and pr2 gripper into the pybullet simulation
create_joint_constraint: create a fixed joint constraint between the kuka arm and its gripper end effector
reset_joint_states: reset joint states on loaded robots using position control and specified joint position arrays
set_simulation_gravity: set gravity and enable real-time simulation mode for the pybullet physics environment
